## Pull request overview

Integrates the `hotcrm` repo as a git submodule and bridges its plugin metadata into the ObjectUI console so HotCRM’s real-world objects/apps render in the UI.

**Changes:**
- Added `examples/hotcrm` submodule and wired its plugin metadata into the merged stack config.
- Updated pnpm workspace globs to include HotCRM plugin packages while excluding the HotCRM monorepo root.
- Added a Vite alias + local stub for `@hotcrm/ai` to satisfy HotCRM plugin imports during console builds.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 10 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-workspace.yaml | Excludes HotCRM root from workspace while including HotCRM plugin packages. |
| objectstack.config.ts | Merges HotCRM objects/apps into the root merged example stack with deduplication. |
| examples/hotcrm-stubs/ai.ts | Adds a lightweight stub module for `@hotcrm/ai` imports. |
| examples/hotcrm-bridge.js | Extracts/normalizes HotCRM plugin objects/apps and provides dedupe merge helper. |
| examples/hotcrm-bridge.d.ts | Provides minimal TS typings so `tsc` doesn’t traverse HotCRM tree. |
| examples/hotcrm | Adds the HotCRM git submodule pointer. |
| apps/console/vite.config.ts | Aliases `@hotcrm/ai` to the local stub for console builds. |
| apps/console/objectstack.shared.ts | Merges HotCRM objects/apps into the console’s shared merged config. |
| .gitmodules | Registers the `examples/hotcrm` submodule. |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>

This root stack config now depends on `./examples/hotcrm-bridge.js`, which (a) imports HotCRM `.ts` source files directly and (b) relies on resolving `@hotcrm/ai` via a Vite-only alias. If `objectstack.config.ts` is loaded in a non-Vite Node context (CLI/runtime config evaluation), it can fail to load due to unresolved TS imports and/or the `@hotcrm/ai` module. Consider making the `@hotcrm/ai` stub resolvable in Node resolution too (e.g., add a real workspace package named `@hotcrm/ai` with `package.json`/exports), and/or avoid importing TS source from JS by pointing the bridge at built JS entrypoints or gating HotCRM imports behind a build-time-only path.
